panels.caption: The builders release their ribbons. The sky answers with constellations no one rehearsed.

panels.text: The first diplomatic circuit ends with an invitation: return not as a repair crew, but as an Arena team.
One host island transforms its Arena into a shared festival of the games encountered so far.
For the first time, personal scores form an official bracket between island delegations.
This is not a reward for finishing the circuit. It is the circuit welcoming you back.
